description: This file defines the OpenClawNodeStorage enum, which provides static methods for constructing various file system paths related to the application's support directories, cache directories, and session-specific subpaths.

methods.name: appSupportDir
methods.description: Returns the URL for the application's support directory, throws an error if unavailable.

methods.name: canvasRoot
methods.description: Returns the URL for the 'canvas' directory inside the app support directory, scoped to a session key.

methods.name: cachesDir
methods.description: Returns the URL for the caches directory, throws an error if unavailable.

methods.name: canvasSnapshotsRoot
methods.description: Returns the URL for the 'canvas-snapshots' directory inside caches, scoped to a session key.
